notes: "The Keepers" correctly takes the Name-only capitalized-plural-label treatment (no GroupOf, no invented type atom, no distribution), Patient is right for a scheduled-occurrence object whose timing is changed, and the To oblique uses the preposition actually used rather than a near-fit Goal or Time.
